breakdown.description: With 60 vol% fibers at 230 GPa, the longitudinal modulus cannot fall below both constituent moduli.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly disregards the incorrect reported value of 2.5 GPa and correctly calculates E_L = 139.2 GPa using the rule of mixtures (230×0.60 + 3×0.40 = 139.2 GPa), which is physically consistent with 60% fiber volume fraction and fiber modulus of 230 GPa.
